outcome: Maternal hemoglobin and platelet counts during pregnancy
cohort: 21 women with Gaucher disease receiving VPRIV (mean age 32.0 years)
finding: VPRIV is safe for conception and pregnancy, with a live birth rate of 84%, good maternal and neonatal outcomes, and improvements in maternal hemoglobin and platelet counts during pregnancy.
mod_finding: All but three deliveries were vaginal; elective cesarean sections were performed in two patients with hip arthroplasty and one after previous cesarean.
